name: rfc2217-client-serial
description: Connects the serial port to a serial port server elsewhere on the network, using RFC 2217.

parameters.label: Server URL
parameters.description: Access-server endpoint as [scheme://]host:port (e.g. url="rfc2217://ser2net.local:4001"); alternative to host/port, cannot be combined with them

parameters.label: Server host
parameters.description: RFC 2217 access-server hostname or address (alternative to url)

parameters.label: Server port
parameters.description: RFC 2217 access-server TCP port (alternative to url)

parameters.label: Baud rate
parameters.description: baud rate to set on the remote UART (real hardware)

parameters.label: Framing
parameters.description: remote UART framing as <data><parity><stop> (data 5-8; parity N/O/E/M/S; stop 1/2), e.g. 8N1 or 7E1

parameters.label: Flow control
parameters.description: remote UART flow control: none, rtscts (hardware) or xonxoff

parameters.label: Assert DTR
parameters.description: assert DTR on the remote UART (many devices/modems need it; the BBC connector has no DTR pin)

parameters.label: Transmit buffer (bytes)
parameters.description: transmit buffer size in bytes; the BBC's /CTS asserts at/above it
